frontier.hypothesis: If the canonical disposition is ever REFUSED, memory/grind/func_80052B00/best_pure_c_fused8_floor17.c - not the pinned HEAD body - is what should ship, because it strictly reduces the cheat surface.
frontier.mechanism: The HEAD body needs eight `register asm("$N")` pins PLUS regfix.txt:3411 to byte-match. The fused body is pin-free and already correct in opcodes, order and offsets; only the GPR names and the delay-slot move remain as build-time paperwork. Fewer cheats for the same bytes is a strict improvement in the fallback outcome.

frontier.hypothesis: The remaining sanctioned modalities (forensics / rederive / synthesis) still have no new axis on this function.
frontier.mechanism: Session 3 found and exhausted the one untested structural dimension (asm-statement granularity). The body is 8 array reads feeding 8 cop2 writes: no arithmetic to restructure, no control flow to reshape, no call to reorder, no type to correct, no data layout to re-attribute.
